## Details

<a id="end_story_sprites"></a>
### [`end_story_sprites`](../../../../src/graphics/end_story_sprites.asm#L6) `$FC40-$FF7F`

*data*

13 sprites of the end of the story of part 2. $8c70 swaps them with the sprites at $54c0-$57ff (pointers $53-$5f). Only quit_to_demo calls $8c70, when $bb bit 7 is set. Part 1 never sets it, so nothing reads these sprites.

- **Referred to by:** [`swap_end_shapes`](../story/end_swaps.md#swap_end_shapes)
